problem: A failed ACK can exceed the frame limit after a handler ran; nested JSON escapes Agent.run (review LIN-11 extends AUDIT-LIN-001 / issue #8; LIN-15)

The worst-case ACK is pre-validated before any handler runs
RecursionError while decoding a reply becomes SDKError('invalid_response')
